title: The page writer cannot delete an answer while its item is open with a lane
why: Items 289 and 290 lost their answers records while open with a lane, against the waiting-page busy-lane path. Found by lane page-answered-sink at 15:34 CST Nov 6, restored by triage at 15:40 CST.
note: Triage 15:43 CST Nov 6. Which write deleted them is unmeasured; triage is the only page writer. Guard: refuse an ArtifactData delete of answers/<id> while items/<id> is open with `lane` or `waits` set, and name the busy-lane rule in the refusal. Coordinator 15:43 CST: named page-answer-delete-guard under the owner's 11:38 ruling (a self-caused mistake means a guard is missing); the coordinator starts it after the guard queue clears.
